description:
[read-only] The experiment's posts split by its compareKey, with the leading variant by its primary metric and n per arm, plus `overlay`: one line per variant (primary metric to date; align=armDay lines arms up from their first post; null = not reported). Small samples: read medians with their n; name a winner only from get_experiment_readout.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/experiments/{id}/results.)

align.description: calendar: by publish date. armDay: arms lined up from their first post.

name: get_experiment_results
title: Experiment results
